insert into user_episode_watch (user_id, subject_id, episode_id, watch_status, watched_at) values
(#{userId}, #{subjectId}, #{episodeId}, 1, current_timestamp) as new on duplicate key update subject_id = new.subject_id, watch_status = new.watch_status, watched_at = coalesce(watched_at, new.watched_at)
